SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
Superior Court
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26001633
DOCKET NO. F00906925
PLAINTIFF – CARRINGTON MORTGAGE SERVICES, LLC
DEFENDANTS- BIANCA ORDONEZ; ET AL.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 23rd DAY OF June 2026
between the hours of 1:30 pm and 5:00 pm in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. the prevailing time at The Leroy F. Smith Building, 60 West Market Street, 14th Floor, Newark, NJ 07102 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the of NEWARK, County of Essex County and State of New Jersey:
Being known as:
LOT: 1 C0804 BLOCK: 294 F/K/A LOT 26 C4H BLOCK: 294.07
APPROXIMATE DIMENSION: CONDOMINIUM UNIT
NEAREST CROSS STREET: CONDOMINIUM UNIT
THE APPROXIMATE UPSET SUM IS $205,377.08 CACULATED THROUGH APRIL 20, 2026 PLUS ANY ADDITIONAL ADVANCE, INTEREST, SHERIFF'S COST AND COMMISSION TO THE DATE OF SALE.
SUBJECT TO A MORTGAGE GIVEN TO NEW JERSEY HOUSING AND MORTGAGE FINANCE AGENCY ON AUGUST 19, 2008, IN THE APPROXIMATE AMOUNT OF $6,301.00, RECORDED ON AUGUST 26, 2008, IN BOOK 12154, AT PAGE 9056.
BEING KNOWN AND DESIGNATED AS UNIT NO. H4 IN "UNIVERSITY HEIGHTS NEIGHBORHOOD CONDOMINIUM" TOGETHER WITH AN UNDIVIDED 1.5152 PERCENTAGE INTEREST IN AN TO THE COMMON ELEMENTS APPURTENANT THERETO, IN ACCORDANCE WITH AND SUBJECT TO THE TERMS AND CONDITIONS OF THE NEW JERSEY CONDOMINIUM ACT (N.J.S.A. 46:8B-1 ET SEQ.) ALL AS SET FORTH IN THE MASTER DEED DATED OCTOBER 10, 1989 AND RECORDED IN THE ESSEX COUNTY REGISTER'S OFFICE ON OCTOBER 13, 1989 IN DEED BOOK 5098 PAGE 288 AND AMENDMENTS TO MASTER DEED DATED JUNE 1, 1990, AND RECORDED JUNE 6, 1990 IN DEED BOOK 5127 PAGE 107 AND CORRECTED AMENDMENTS TO MASTER DEED DATED NOVEMBER 29, 1990 AND RECORDED NOVEMBER 30, 1990 IN DEED BOOK 5148 PAGE 661 AND SECOND AMENDMENT TO MASTER DEED FEBRUARY 18, 1992 AND RECORDED MARCH 24, 1992 IN DEED BOOK 5206 PAGE 72, TOGETHER WITH ANY AMENDMENTS OR SUPPLEMENTS ATTACHED THERETO.
THE SALE IS SUBJECT TO UNPAID AND ASSESSMENTS, TAX, WATER AND SEWER LIENS AND OTHER MUNICIPAL ASSESSMENTS. THE AMOUNT DUE CAN BE OBTAINED FROM THE LOCAL TAXING AUTHORITY. PURSUANT TO NJSA 46:8B-21 THE SALE MAY ALSO BE SUBJECT TO THE LIMITED LIEN PRIORITY OF ANY CONDOMINIUM/HOMEOWNER ASSOCIATION LIENS WHICH MAY EXIST. THIS SALE MAY BE FURTHER SUBJECT TO RESTRICTIONS, REVERSIONS, AND EASEMENTS OF RECORD.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
312 LITTLETON AVENUE UNIT 4H NEWARK, NJ 07103
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Essex County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Essex County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $191,581.56 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Amir D. Jones
SHERIFF
Advertised
DATED: May 8, 2026
LOGS LEGALGROUP LLP
14000 COMMERCE PKY
SUITE B
MOUNT LAUREL, NJ 08054
(856) 793-3080
